cn-command-item.reason: The composed palette uses the Combobox item and its existing selected, disabled and focus rendering.

cn-command-item-indicator.reason: Selecting a command closes the dialog, leaving no persistent check indicator.

cn-command-list.reason: The shared Combobox popover owns viewport clipping, overflow and keyboard scrolling.

cn-navigation-menu-content.reason: The pinned Base UI activation-direction variant is invalid in the standalone compiler and drives a shared sliding viewport. Trellis positions each native popover and keeps the generated Vega paint.

cn-navigation-menu-popup.reason: The pinned easing utility is invalid in the standalone compiler and the sizes depend on the Base UI viewport. The native popup sizes to its panel content.

cn-navigation-menu-positioner.reason: The native popover uses the shared viewport caps and CSSOM positioning in place of measured Base UI dimensions and position transitions.

cn-toast.reason: Base UI toast stacking and swipe utilities read --toast-index, --toast-height and --toast-swipe-movement-*, which Base UI's runtime sets. Trellis uses a CSS grid with native touch gestures; the Base UI utilities overlap the grid items
